description.value: Pho Quynh Express is a Vietnamese quick-service restaurant chain in Vancouver specializing in pho, vermicelli bowls, and rice dishes with grilled lemongrass meats. The brand operates multiple downtown locations and offers online ordering with pickup. The 1691 Main Street node in OSM does not appear on the brand's own website, raising questions about its current operating status.
